method_note: The 2026 edition (Sapporo, 27-29 Oct 2026) has not yet taken place, so APISAT 2025 (Seoul Olympic Parktel, 27-29 Oct 2025) was analysed. Counted 94 oral technical sessions from the official final programme PDF (Parallel Session Schedule): sessions numbered 1-112, excluding 14 slots marked 'Closed Meeting' with no title and 4 'K-UAM Safety Technology Innovation Forum (Closed Session)' blocks. Plenaries and poster sessions not counted; per-session paper counts were not extracted. Tracks are the programme's session prefixes (AD, SM, CP, DCA, SSA, SE, Os), with the names taken from the programme's topic list. Each session = 1 unit split across at most 2 keywords. Aerodynamics/structures/propulsion sessions without a specific title cue were mapped to their track's main keyword. Keywords below 0.02 (launch, earth-obs, space-comm, autonomy, space-systems, exploration, space-science, trajectory, estimation, mechatronics, motion-planning; together 0.106 of session-units) were dropped and the remaining weights renormalized to sum to 1.
